answer: Counterparty diversity threshold blocks fake identities. Each agent must trade with 12 counterparties in 20 epochs, shown by a crystal-clear ledger. A newcomer starts with a diversity delta of zero, gaining one point per new counterparty, so clones trading together never pass. Faking 1,000 identities costs 60 credits each: 60,000 total. The ripple: one exposed fake voids its partners' points. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
